messages:
alex: Heads-up — after the role rename deploy (viewer -> read-only) I can see the Project Keys page while logged in as a read-only user. Screenshot: https://redwood/screenshots/abc123 :eyes:

maria: repro steps?

alex: 1) sign in as read-only user
2) navigate to /console/project/PROJECT_ID/keys
3) link in sidebar visible and page loads; API call to /api/keys returns 403

jordan: sounds like frontend gating still checks for 'viewer' enum. backend denies so probably UX-only leak. Can you paste the gating code?

alex: here's the offending check:
```
// Sidebar.tsx
const canSeeKeys = role === 'admin' || role === 'editor' || role === 'viewer';
// after rename we use 'read-only' instead of 'viewer'
```

samira: is any KMS metadata or ARNs displayed? that could be escalation. also need audit logs for the user actions.

alex: UI shows key names and creation timestamps, and the KMS key ARN is visible. secret material not returned — GET /api/key/:id -> 403. attached snippet of response body (metadata only)

kevin: deploybot shows console deploy 30m ago: commit b7a2c1f. tagging @deploy-bot to confirm: did the change include role rename migration?

deploy-bot: Deploy started by kevin — console-service @ b7a2c1f — finished ✅

maria: grabbing audit logs from stack: searching for console list_keys and kms decrypt. so far list_keys by user_x at 1838654310, no decrypt calls. KMS audit shows no Decrypt API calls.

samira: ok — exposure limited to metadata, but KMS ARN present -> potential for targeted social engineering. I'm leaning P2 for triage. patch the UI ASAP: check both legacy and new roles or add feature flag fallback.

jordan: agree. quick fix: update gating to accept both values and ship as hotfix. longer-term: migration plan + server-side feature flags.

alex: created incident ticket INC-2026-092 and posted to #incidents. assigned to kevin for rollback/hotfix.

kevin: I'll prep a hotfix branch that checks both enums and roll forward in 15m if CI green. also recommending we add unit tests around role enums and a warning in the console deploy docs.

samira: assign RFC: role-renames-migration — include steps: aliasing old names, UI+API dual-accept mode, audit logging, KMS exposure review, and communications to customers. I own the RFC.

maria: I'll attach the minimal repro + screenshots + audit snippets to the incident ticket.

jordan: we should also add a lint rule to catch enum usage in UI gating code.

samira: good call. Thanks everyone. Please post when hotfix is live and include the new release sha.
